selection_method: Python random.Random(seed).choice over three independently authored choices each for garment, setting and event; no project candidate data inspected.
request_owned: Three independent different random complex concepts
Generate prompt and image and test actual visual reflection

hard_pixel_gates.one_piece_continuity: Covered front and hip fabric visibly form one connected swimsuit
hard_pixel_gates.single_shoulder: Broad left shoulder strap and bare right shoulder visibly distinct
hard_pixel_gates.diagonal_wrap: Diagonal panel overlap has a readable physical edge; a shadow or printed diagonal alone fails
hard_pixel_gates.waist_keyhole: Small right side-waist opening clearly visible and not hidden by hand/towel
hard_pixel_gates.hip_band: Wide continuous hip band visible connecting covered front and side
hard_pixel_gates.event: Right hand visibly catches towel billowing beyond waist; cloth does not cover focal construction
hard_pixel_gates.setting_light: Glass conservatory, pool and shallow floor water coexist with warm sunlight and cool pool fill
hard_pixel_gates.reference: Face and dark wavy hair visibly retain supplied reference appearance

decision_policy: Each mandatory gate PASS only with visible evidence; ambiguous or partial is FAIL. Prompt/runtime audits and candidate exposure are separate from pixels. No baseline-vs-data causal improvement claim from a single rendered condition.
